topic: Toji's last words about Megumi made Gojo the boy's guardian
title: Toji's Final Words Handed Gojo A Son To Raise
description: After Hollow Purple, Toji tells Gojo that Megumi will be sold to the Zenin clan. I think that was a handoff, not a warning. Chapters 75 and 59.
comment: Was Toji's message about Megumi a handoff to Gojo, or just spite at the Zenin clan? Pick one.
end_text: THE ONE MAN GOJO COULDN'T READ

lines.text: Toji's last words gave Gojo the one thing he never planned on.

shot.fallback: scarred man looking up at a white haired student

lines.text: Hollow Purple has just put Toji down in chapter 75.

shot.fallback: huge purple energy beam across a courtyard

lines.text: He thinks of his late wife, and of their son, Megumi.
Then he tells Gojo that Megumi will be sold to the Zenin clan in a few years.

shot.search: Toji tells Gojo Megumi Zenin clan
shot.fallback: tired man speaking to a student

lines.text: He says Gojo can do whatever he wants with that.

shot.fallback: man giving a quiet look to a young sorcerer

lines.text: Here's the detail that gets me. Toji planned to sell Megumi himself, chapter 59.

shot.search: Toji planned sell Megumi Zenin chapter 59
shot.fallback: father handing a boy to a clan elder

lines.text: So why hand a rival the warning that ruins the deal?

shot.fallback: stern man in an old estate

lines.text: The boy he meant to sell becomes the boy Gojo takes out of the Zenin clan's hands.

shot.fallback: tall teacher leading a boy out of an estate gate

lines.text: Gojo becomes Megumi's mentor and gives him a real chance. Chapter 59.

shot.fallback: blindfolded teacher with a quiet teenage student

lines.text: Maybe it was spite. But spite doesn't tell a rival where the child ends up.

shot.fallback: man glaring at an old clan hall

lines.text: I think it was the one decent thing he ever did.

shot.fallback: man and a young boy sitting together

lines.text: Toji did more to Gojo than land one hit.

shot.fallback: two silhouettes under a glowing sky

lines.text: Because Toji's last words gave Gojo the one thing he never planned on.

shot.fallback: white haired man looking at a boy
